Since \(I\) is the incenter and \(\angle A=60^\circ\),  
\[
\angle BIC = 90^\circ+\frac{\angle A}{2}=120^\circ.
\]
Also \(BC=\sqrt3\). Thus the circumradius of \(\triangle BCI\) is
\[
R=\frac{BC}{2\sin\angle BIC}
=\frac{\sqrt3}{2\sin120^\circ}
=\frac{\sqrt3}{2\cdot \frac{\sqrt3}{2}}=1.
\]
\[
\boxed{1}
\]
